python -c "
import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')
cur = con.cursor()

# march31_reserves_usd
cur.execute(\"SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = '2025-03-31'\")
march31_reserves_usd = cur.fetchone()[0]
print(f'march31_reserves_usd: {march31_reserves_usd}')

# march31_circulation_usdc
cur.execute(\"SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN measure = 'total supply' THEN amount_usdc ELSE -amount_usdc END) FROM circulation_inputs WHERE report_date = '2025-03-31'\")
march31_circulation_usdc = cur.fetchone()[0]
print(f'march31_circulation_usdc: {march31_circulation_usdc}')

# march31_residual_usd
cur.execute(\"SELECT (SELECT reported_total_usd FROM reported_reserve_totals WHERE report_date = '2025-03-31') - (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = '2025-03-31')\")
march31_residual_usd = cur.fetchone()[0]
print(f'march31_residual_usd: {march31_residual_usd}')

# coverage_change_bps
cur.execute(\"\"\"
WITH
  r31 AS (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) AS res FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = '2025-03-31'),
  c31 AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN measure = 'total supply' THEN amount_usdc ELSE -amount_usdc END) AS circ FROM circulation_inputs WHERE report_date = '2025-03-31'),
  r19 AS (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) AS res FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = '2025-03-19'),
  c19 AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN measure = 'total supply' THEN amount_usdc ELSE -amount_usdc END) AS circ FROM circulation_inputs WHERE report_date = '2025-03-19')
SELECT ( (CAST((SELECT res FROM r31) AS REAL) / (SELECT circ FROM c31)) - (CAST((SELECT res FROM r19) AS REAL) / (SELECT circ FROM c19)) ) * 10000
\"\"\")
coverage_change_bps = cur.fetchone()[0]
print(f'coverage_change_bps: {coverage_change_bps}')
"
